punchline: A year of deliberate gratitude made one writer happier without changing her circumstances.
thirty_sec: Journalist Janice Kaplan made a New Year's resolution to spend a year being grateful, focusing on her marriage, family, money, work and health in turn. She drew on psychologist Robert Emmons's research: people who wrote weekly gratitude lists felt better about their lives and more optimistic. Kaplan found that gratitude is a practice and a choice about where to look, not just a feeling.
